name: GitHub Creature
summary: Turns any GitHub profile into a fantasy creature with a generated portrait, lore and stats.
description: Enter a GitHub username or profile URL and get a fantasy creature generated from that account: a creature portrait, a written lore description and stats such as contributions, followers, stars and percentile rank. Every creature gets a shareable page and appears on leaderboards ranked by stars and by contributions.
